name: Kirkland Signature Plain Water Bagels (Bakery 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Traditional boiled and baked plain bagels made from enriched unbleached flour without seeds, onion flakes, or whole grains. Provides easily digested complex carbohydrates that help bind the stool.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly to soften the interior. Top with dairy-free spread, seedless jelly, or sliced turkey breast. Avoid everything bagels with seeds and garlic.
